app_name: Biometric (MIUI face unlock, SenseTime FaceAuth SDK 1.37.4-A140026)
ai_summary: On-device face unlock. The APK is a library app (no components) that publishes a Binder service 'miui.face.FaceService' consumed by SystemUI. Java (com.ts.faceauth.FaceAuthManager -> FaceAuthNative, 25 JNI methods) drives a 101.8 MiB native SDK libstfaceunlockocl.so which runs eight embedded Caffe (caffe-lite) CNNs through SenseTime hpc/pplwrapper with precompiled Adreno OpenCL kernels: Hunter detector, 106-point occlusion aligner, ANN pose regressor, eye-state classifier, MTNet quality attributes, RGB full-frame liveness, and a MobileNetV2-T6 face embedder for 1:1 matching. The eight models are shipped as STEF/v3 containers (plaintext 16-byte header + encrypted payload + 257-byte trailer); the payload is a tar (meta.conf st_model.ModelMeta protobuf + model.bin + rel.prototxt) but stays encrypted at rest, so no weight tensor is recoverable statically.

features.name: face unlock (1:1 authentication)
pipeline: colour convert + rotate by FaceOrientation bitmask (UP=1,LEFT=2,DOWN=4,RIGHT=8)
cosine match vs enrolled template (FeatureCmp, threshold 0.905) -> status 201 = unlock ok
features.notes: Status mapping in FaceAuthManager.stFaceAuthStatusToFaceAuthResult (60+ codes). Thresholds: DEFAULT_VERIFY_THRESHOLD=0.905, DEFAULT_LIVENESS_THRESHOLD=0.9 (floats read from .data).

features.name: face enrolment
pipeline: per frame: detect + quality + pose + eye-state gates
feature extraction (same MobileNetV2-T6 embedder) for N accepted frames
template update: stfaceunlock::TemplateHepler -> pb::TemplateFile (magic STFACEUNLOCK, version 1.0.1) at /data/data/com.miui.face/files/template_file.data
template file compressed on disk ('Compression template file' strings)
features.notes: Enrol cap enforced via ST_FACE_AUTH_ERROR_TEMPLDATE_FILE_UPPER_LIMIT (-1008). pb::TemplateFile stores Direction, Points, Feature and the enrolment Image.

features.name: liveness / anti-spoofing
entrypoints: st_auth_unlock(st_image_t*, int config, int*, int) with liveness bit in config
features.notes: Additional liveness families exist as symbols (live::GeneralFacePredictorV7..V20, FramePredictorAntispoofing*, Depth/DualPD predictors, M_Liveness_Antispoofing_General.10.x) but only one liveness blob is shipped in this APK.

features.name: batch evaluation / QA
pipeline: dataset directory -> detect -> align -> quality -> liveness -> verify
features.notes: Returns -1 when either path argument is null (JNI disassembly at 0x36dc).

reimplementation.limitations: All eight model payloads are encrypted (STEF/v3, entropy 8.0, no standard codec, no repeating-XOR key, key derived at run time by the SenseTime protector/licence chain), so no weights could be extracted. Model topology (MobileNetV2-T6 embedder, RPN detector, 106-landmark aligner, pose/eye/quality/liveness heads) and the I/O contract are implemented with deterministic random init; numeric outputs are meaningless. Per-net preprocessing mean/scale and the detection/quality thresholds are also inside the encrypted container and are unknown.

data_pipelines.name: face unlock authentication (1:1 match -> keyguard unlock)

trigger.detail: SystemUI calls code 3 (CODE_AUTHENTICATE) on service 'miui.face.FaceService' (raw Binder published by MiuiBioApp); warm-up via code 2 (CODE_PRE_INIT_AUTHEN); USER_PRESENT broadcast releases a pre-initialised client

transport.format: ImageFormat.YUV_420_888 (35) -> NV21 byte[] in com.miui.image.Yuv; 460800 bytes
transport.timestamp: absent (Image.getTimestamp never read; timing is wall clock)
transport.cadence: sensor default; ImageReader maxImages=1 with immediate close, frames dropped while SDK busy; auth also skips frames while mIsDetecting and every other frame after a no-face result

preprocess.detail: CommonFun::GetMean @0x143398 with cv_model_net_config_t; constants inside encrypted meta.conf

postprocess.detail: FaceVerify::CompareFeature @0x123bd0 -> cv_common_feature_comparator_get_distance (dot product, Q16 fast path 2^-16 @0x230d04) -> normalize_score_by_model -> stsdk::FeatureCmp::normalizeScore @0x2446b4 -> protector::NormModel::Run

consumer.detail: status 0 -> FaceUnlockManager.handlePassed -> onFaceAuthenticated -> MiuiFaceService MSG_ON_AUTHENTICATE -> ClientMonitor.onAuthenticationSucceeded -> receiver.transact(203) to SystemUI with Face('Miuiface1',1,123456); failures delivered as acquired codes (transact 202) / error (205)

3000 ms -> MSG 1008 -> stopDetect + onFaceAuthFailed -> error 3 to client
no fallback inside Biometric.apk; PIN/pattern policy is SystemUI-side

trigger.detail: code 5 (CODE_ENROLL) with token, Surface, detectArea/enrollArea RectF, step count and timeout; cancel via code 6, guide via code 101 (EXT_CMD)

transport.source: same Camera2 front camera; caller preview Surface plus internal ImageReader
transport.roi: guide rect set via FaceAuthManager.setDetectArea -> st_auth_set_roi(rotated rect) per frame; RotateMaskRect in Java + RotateRect in native
transport.cadence: every frame on this device (munch not in get_frame_nonsequence)

preprocess.detail: same colour convert / resize / rotate / align / pose / occlusion as auth

postprocess.detail: JNI return = face id (st_auth_enroll user_id out-param); rc[0] = status; EnrollResult{mFaceId,mEnrollStatus,mNativeStatus}
19 KEEP -> wait for EXT_CMD 0; 36 -> reset(); 0 -> success (faceId+1 reported); 4/5/8-11/15-18/21/23/27/30/33 -> coaching codes
<filesDir>/template_file.data, protobuf pb.TemplateFile magic STFACEUNLOCK, version 1.0.1, features cv_feature_serialize/degarble, compressed

fallback.behaviour: stopFromBp: close camera, reset() if other faces remain else release(false)

unknowns: CNN weights: all eight STEF payloads encrypted; decryption key produced at runtime by protector::ModelLoader + sdk_protector_* (AES/RC4/RSA/MD5) from the licence chain; not present in plaintext in the APK.
Exact per-net preprocessing (mean value / scale / crop affine) held in the encrypted tar member meta.conf (st_model.ModelMeta -> st_model.CaffeParam).
Detection threshold and quality thresholds (set at runtime via FaceDetection::SetDetectThreshold; no plaintext constants).
Per-ISO-3166 threshold table used by st_auth_set_threshold_by_international_code (only the Java area->code map and area.co cache are visible).
Full liveness ensemble composition: live::GeneralFacePredictorV7..V20 / FramePredictorAntispoofing* / Depth / DualPD symbols exist but only one liveness blob is shipped for this device.
Embedding dimension (512 assumed) and whether FeatureCmp applies the PCA projection / score-normalisation table (st_model.PCAParam) - config is inside the encrypted container.
Ghidra decompilation of libstfaceunlockocl.so did not complete within the shared import budget (auto-analysis of a 101.8 MiB binary); native evidence is capstone disassembly + symbol/DWARF analysis.

Whether the native preprocessor mirrors (horizontally flips) the camera image before the detector: no mirroring exists in the Java path, and the Caffe graph ships a Reverse layer plus hpc::pplwrapper Reverse kernels, but the prototxt that would show whether they are used is inside the encrypted container.
Default template Identifier namespace: st_auth_set_identifier is never called by this app; the value stored in pb.TemplateFile field 2 could not be observed statically.
